title: Braised Bok Choy with Garlic and Ginger
description: A simple and flavorful side dish made with bok choy, garlic, and ginger. This recipe is great for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: 1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
2. Add garlic and ginger to the skillet and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
3. Add bok choy to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until wilted.
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
